name: Konohana Saori
source: Yuma's wealthy and intelligent classmate. Rumor has it she's an angel from heaven because of her sweet and gentle personality and demeanor. When she's selected for the "Sex Royale" she often wanders from her protector [url=/c17175]Mai[/url] so she can be caught by Yuma in order to live out her sexual fantasies. Despite the rules of the game she always takes the role of a submissive even when she catches Yuma allowing him to earn points instead.
